verdict.rationale: Statsig documents its own stats engine. Experiments report metric lifts with confidence intervals and support power analysis. The docs name CUPED and stratified sampling as measurement tools, and a community comment praises its statistical rigor. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the statistical methodology (frequentist vs Bayesian choice, sequential testing details), variance-reduction docs beyond a single Warehouse Native mention, in-depth first-party methodology pages, independent hands-on verification.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can trust a documented statistics engine (Bayesian or frequentist, with variance-reduction options) behind experiment results

citations.quote: reports metric lifts with confidence intervals
Statsig offers a full suite of experiment measurement tools, including CUPED, Stratified Sampling, Switchback Tests, and more.
Modern statistical engine for running analyses on existing experiments from third-party or internal systems.
A power analysis tells you how much traffic and how many days it needs
we were impressed how they balanced dev velocity & stat rigor
